note: The pure half of player/foray-progress.js, one case per assertion of foray-progress.test.js: the row (makeProgress, isProgressRecord, progressKey), the resume decision (resumePoint: MIN_RESUME_SEC, NEAR_END_SEC, the live total and last index, #40's drift verdicts against a live running order, FD-05's `present: false`), reconcileSegment, percentDone and the two labels. Rows are written with a fixed `now`. The storage half is storage.json; the 5 s throttle's own arithmetic is resume-rules/foray-cadence.json (NE-09). Port: NE-29s (ResumeRules gains the thresholds and drift verdicts; Rows gains segment id plus offset).
